title: Read the apply-twice derivation
description: You can track the two supplied arguments through the displayed substitutions.

steps.description: The outer lambda receives g as f. The written substitution targets the body of that lambda.
Both uses of f now read g. The remaining lambda still waits for a value for x.

steps.description: The worked derivation ends at g(g a). You can read the inner application before the outer one.
